description: Calculates how much of a distant target the Earth's curvature hides, from the surface distance, the observer's eye height, the target's height and an assumed refraction coefficient. Returns the hidden and visible height, the tangent-plane drop, the horizon distance and dip, the maximum mutual sight-line range and the midpoint bulge on a smooth sphere of radius 6,371.0084 km.

distance.description: Surface distance between the observer and the target, along the ground: 0 to 1000 km, or 0 to 621 miles when units is imperial.

eyeHeight.description: Height of the observer's eye above the surface: 0 to 1000 m, or feet when units is imperial. Defaults to 2 m (6.56 ft).

refraction.description: Assumed refraction coefficient k from -0.3 to 0.3: 0 is straight rays and positive values bend rays toward the surface. Defaults to 0.

targetHeight.description: Height of the target's top above the same surface: 0 to 1000 m, or feet when units is imperial. Defaults to 10 m (32.8 ft).

units.description: Metric uses kilometres and metres; imperial uses miles and feet. Metric without it.

name: calculate_curvature
title: Earth curvature calculator
